title: Object abroad too large to move

tellings.quote: There is reportedly an object that is not in this country that is so large it cannot be moved.

plain: Somewhere outside the United States, the claim goes, there is a recovered object so large that it cannot be moved. Congressman Eric Burlison tells Michels this as something he has been told, and he gives no place or date. If true, it would mean that at least one crashed or recovered craft is too big to be taken away and hidden.
